steps.title: Inspect the target project layout
steps.description: Read the existing youtube_to_mp3 repository: entry points, dependencies, existing tests. Write down what is already there before designing anything.

steps.title: Record the command line contract
steps.description: Fix the CLI: input is one YouTube URL, output is a TXT transcript next to a working directory. No other behaviour is promised.

steps.title: Define the download pipeline
steps.description: Decide the stages: URL validation, audio download, audio preparation, transcription, TXT output. Each stage is a separate module with one responsibility.

steps.title: Decide the audio format and the transcription input
steps.description: Pick the intermediate audio format and sample rate, and record why; the transcription stage must not care how the file was produced.

steps.title: Implement URL validation
steps.description: One function that accepts or rejects a URL, with tests for both outcomes and no network access in the test.

steps.title: Implement the audio download stage
steps.description: Download the audio track of one URL into the working directory. A failure must be reported, never silently swallowed.

steps.title: Implement the audio preparation stage
steps.description: Convert the downloaded audio into the format the transcription stage expects, with a deterministic file name.

steps.title: Implement the transcription stage
steps.description: Transcribe the prepared audio into one text string. The transcript must be reproducible for the same input.

steps.title: Write the TXT output
steps.description: Write the transcript to a TXT file next to the working directory and print its path. The TXT file is the deliverable of the pilot.

steps.title: Test the end-to-end pipeline on one URL
steps.description: One real URL from start to TXT output, asserting the file exists and is not empty.

steps.title: Test the failure paths
steps.description: An invalid URL, an unreachable network and a missing output directory must each produce one clear error, not a crash.

steps.title: Review the pilot and hand it over
steps.description: Read the produced TXT file, confirm the pipeline does what this plan promised, and record what is deliberately out of scope.
